name: qlrisk_price_overnight_index_swap
title: Price a OvernightIndexSwap
description:
Price one Overnight Index Swap - floating leg tied to overnight rate (qlrisk OvernightIndexSwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, fixed_rate_pct*, overnight_index=SOFR, pay_fixed=true, payment_frequency=annual, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4} gives NPV 10,052.92 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
